item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"remaining_heap_depth","expression":"max(0, (len(self._heap) - 1).bit_length() - 1)","rationale":"Heap restoration traverses a number of levels logarithmic in the remaining heap size."},{"name":"queue_size","expression":"len(self._heap)","rationale":"Captures residual size-dependent heap maintenance and list storage costs."},{"name":"requires_restoration","expression":"int(len(self._heap) > 1)","rationale":"Distinguishes singleton removal from replacement and heap restoration."},{"name":"requires_comparisons","expression":"int(len(self._heap) > 2)","rationale":"Distinguishes removals that invoke request comparisons from the smallest heaps."}],"hypothesis":"Instruction count is driven primarily by heap depth and request comparisons, with separate overhead for singleton removal and restoration of a nontrivial heap."}
